reason: Hypothesis A proposes a novel intervention (Mg(ReO4)2 coating) that extends prior work on magnesium perrhenate as an oil additive to a solid pre-coating on HEA surfaces, with a physically sound mechanism for high-temperature stability and a clear falsification experiment; Hypothesis B largely restates the exact finding from its cited evidence (2D HEA nanoflakes forming a-C tribolayer from ethanol) without a substantive extension, and its mechanism depends on trace organic vapors that may not be present across the required wide temperature range.
